exposure: uterine arterial chemoembolization (UACE) combined with uterine curettage
methotrexate (MTX) injection combined with uterine curettage
cohort: The study included 86 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) from January 2019 to December 2021.
finding: UACE combined with uterine curettage significantly improved the total effective rate, reduced intraoperative bleeding, and shortened recovery times for CSP patients compared to MTX combined with uterine curettage.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was found to be an influencing factor for postoperative efficacy in patients with cesarean scar pregnancy.
gest_age: Gestational age was identified as an independent factor influencing the postoperative efficacy of treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy.
